signal: Alvys raised a $40M Series B led by RTP Global to expand its AI freight software for carriers and brokers

email.body1:
Ryan, saw Alvys closed its $40M Series B to push the AI freight platform deeper into large carriers and brokers.

Scaling that fast usually outruns RevOps: in-market accounts surface faster than the team can route and touch them, and that signal-to-action latency is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alvys off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for Alvys.

Post-raise, the board's pipeline expectations jump faster than headcount can. Most RevOps teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late, and recovering a quarter is brutal.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alvys needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for Alvys.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alvys's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I'll tailor it to Alvys either way.
